dedupe_keys.name: grid3 nigeria education facilities school locations

description: This Humanitarian Data Exchange dataset from GRID3 gives point locations of education facilities across Nigeria, which it defines as designated institutions providing learning spaces for the teaching of students. It was extracted from the GRID3 site set up for the government of Nigeria and compiles sources listed as GRID3, NMIS (the Nigeria MDG Information System), OSGOF (the Office of the Surveyor General of the Federation), Proxy Logistics, eHealth Africa polio programme data and a Bauchi JSI MCSP collection; the methodology is recorded as a registry. Files are a Nigeria schools shapefile of about 7.8 MB updated in August 2023, an education shapefile of about 20 MB and an education facilities workbook of about 15 MB, both from November 2021. Coverage: all of Nigeria, with the dataset date given as 20 December 2020. Access: shapefile and XLSX downloads on HDX, created 2021-11-24 and last modified 2023-08-17, with a stated yearly update frequency that has not been kept. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution; free. Caveats: the sources differ in date and completeness, school type and condition are not guaranteed, and the geopreview was removed from HDX. Simulation uses are school exposure to floods and conflict, shelter and evacuation site planning, and access analyses. Related records: the Nigeria building footprints and residential archetypes records, the GLOSI school infrastructure library and Giga school connectivity maps; the services piece holds GRID3 health facilities.
name: GRID3 Nigeria education facilities (school locations)
provider: GRID3 (Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development), published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange
